decisions.search-first: Adopt focused source/tool-availability preflight and adopt/extend/build comparison, not automatic every-feature workflow. Native OMP owns dispatch/tools; no auth inspection.
decisions.motion-foundations: Do not register: unqualified SSR initial-opacity claim and mounted alternate element swaps, global library/token mandates and device core count heuristics conflict with existing stack-sensitive guidance.
decisions.motion-patterns: Do not register: modal sample lacks focus trap/Escape/scroll lock despite requirements; scaleY accordion leaves focusable hidden content and layout gap; broad always-exit/5 children thresholds unsupported.
decisions.motion-advanced: Do not register: useLongPress timer lacks unmount/pointercancel cleanup, sheet example missing dialog focus handling; do not promote copy-paste production-ready claim.
decisions.remotion-video-creation: Defer: existing user choice Hyperframes; separate Remotion runtime/licensing not authorized; not install alternate framework.
